notes: Identity assessment: supplied canonical text is a full primary research article, with title Effects of Need for Cognition on Message Evaluation, Recall, and Persuasion; authors John T. Cacioppo, Richard E. Petty, and Katherine J. Morris; Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 1983, volume 45, number 4, pages 805–818. These agree with the neutral original reference. The provenance header gives DOI 10.1037/0022-3514.45.4.805; no external identity verification performed. Target identified by Experiment 1, message-evaluation outcome (five-item general index described on p. 808), and Need for Cognition X Argument Quality interaction explicitly reported on p. 809, rather than the distinct argument-quality main effect F = 160.86 on that page. Printed F statistic retained without effect-size conversion. Canonical text renders the numerator df as lowercase l; test notation normalised to F(1, 110), while evidence quote retains literal canonical text. No PDF supplied, so no PDF rendering available. Only assigned original es and p fields assessed; all other fields are unassigned placeholders.
